name: Legend of the Sword
author: Doge164
description: Go above the cube portal as the wave between the spikes at 41.4% and then hold to the ceiling. Fall from the ceiling at 44.6% and then spam to go through an invisible teleport portal and not die during the transition. Navigate through the following gameplay as the wave until 53% where after the last blue pad, you need to spam under the cube portal and then hold to the ceiling shortly after at 54%. Stay at the ceiling until the end from there.
